overview: Wave Accounting uses OAuth 2.0. You register an OAuth application in the Wave Accounting developer console, receive a Client ID and Client Secret, then redirect users through Wave Accounting's authorisation flow. Wave Accounting issues a scoped access token on completion.

steps.title: Open the Wave Accounting developer console
steps.description: Go to the Wave Accounting developer portal or OAuth application settings page to register a new OAuth application.

steps.title: Create an OAuth application
steps.description: Register a new OAuth app (sometimes called 'OAuth Integration', 'API App', or 'Client Application'). Enter an application name and any required details.
steps.tip: The app name is shown to users on the Wave Accounting authorisation screen — use something recognisable.

steps.title: Set the redirect (callback) URL
steps.description: Add the Nolixan callback URL as an allowed redirect URI in the OAuth app settings. The exact callback URL is shown in your Nolixan environment settings.
steps.warning: The callback URL must match exactly. Mismatches cause 'redirect_uri_mismatch' errors during auth.

steps.title: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
steps.description: After creating the app, Wave Accounting will display a Client ID and Client Secret. Copy both and store them securely. The Client Secret may only be shown once.
steps.warning: Never expose the Client Secret in client-side code or public repositories.

steps.title: Configure and connect
steps.description: In Nolixan, create an integration config with the Wave Accounting Client ID, Client Secret, and required scopes. Then initiate the OAuth flow for each user.

tips: Access tokens expire — Nolixan auto-refreshes them using the refresh token.
If a user revokes access, they must re-authorise via the OAuth flow.
